raw_evidence.locator: PDF p.2 II-A, Fig.1; p.3 II-C, Fig.3
raw_evidence.raw: 13824 BL × 32 WL × 3 SSL/block; 64 blocks/subarray; BL length 144 μm
raw_evidence.condition: 作者CIM结构/RC模型，32 nm逻辑外围；不是量产页手册
raw_evidence.adoption: 原样保留物理几何。两subarray、128 blocks构成一份矩阵；一WL/一SSL的一页为13824 bit=1728 Byte。

raw_evidence.raw: 16-layer, 64 Gb SLC; ION mean 2 nA, sigma 0.3 nA; IOFF <0.5 pA; Vg=1 V, VBL=0.2 V, Vpass=4.5 V
raw_evidence.condition: SGVC实际器件电流；full-block random code；非完整CIM芯片速度
raw_evidence.adoption: 二阈值SLC依据。NAND-04的32 WL结构另属模型，不把16层和32层说成同一实测芯片。

raw_evidence.raw: WL setup 303 ns; BL setup 12 ns @50% sparsity; SL setup 530–750 ns @max-bit input; SL capacitance ~16 pF
raw_evidence.condition: RC/HSPICE估计，64-block subarray；SL不是完整SLC read cycle
raw_evidence.adoption: WL每输出组一次(8次/向量)；BL和SL每求值一次(64次)。SL中点640 ns仅插值情景；复制108份使电流接近原负载，范围仍以适配成功为条件。

raw_evidence.raw: Tread ~1 μs with multibit output; ~10 μA MAC current; 7–8-bit SA resolution
raw_evidence.condition: 加速器设计预估，非单cell测量；包括多位SA输出
raw_evidence.adoption: 仅对530–750 ns阵列建立加共同ADC的微秒量级交叉检查，不把1 μs再叠加或当独立硅证据。

raw_evidence.raw: Both states programmed with write-verify; programming voltage ~20 V
raw_evidence.condition: 两阈值都细调以控制导通电流
raw_evidence.adoption: 完整P必须含charge-pump建立、所有program/verify循环、恢复及可计算终点；完整P未给，保持未知。

raw_evidence.raw: Sacrifice one or two WLs per block for known-code SA calibration; on-the-fly calibration
raw_evidence.condition: 读取已知码后校准SA；重写/漂移可能需要重新校准
raw_evidence.adoption: 主情景1个校准WL，另核对2个。擦除后每块增加1或2个完整校准页program；C_cal为整矩阵事务的总校准时间，未报告，参数化。

raw_evidence.raw: MLC: tPROG 1300/2500 μs, tBERS 15/45 ms, tR 77 μs; TLC: 1630/5000 μs, 15/45 ms, 100 μs (typ/max)
raw_evidence.adoption: 仅说明商品存储模式完整周期及粒度不同；全部不代入SLC主情景，也不充当SLC上/下界。

raw_evidence.raw: Fast SLC burst ~11% interior tPROG reduction; first/last ~5.5%; pump held between pages
raw_evidence.condition: 332-WL QLC产品的SLC-cache burst；未给SLC绝对P或E
raw_evidence.adoption: 证明泵建立/最终恢复必须计入有限窗口；不把11%或QLC >85 MB/s作为SLC绝对时间，不采用burst收益。

raw_evidence.raw: QLC 4b/c; 6 planes; 16 kB page; tPROG 1.3 ms; die throughput 75 MB/s
raw_evidence.adoption: 仅核对die/plane吞吐与页cycle不同；不代入SLC单更新域。

raw_evidence.raw: 128×128 INT8; BS=128 Byte; BR(full)=16384 Byte; R0: 8 weight planes, 16 ADC/plane; (TI,TA,TD)=(2,10,2)/(5,20,5)/(10,50,10) ns; 128-bit write interface
raw_evidence.condition: 已接受公共工程选择；ACIM校准近似部分和、128×24-bit输出

mapping.native_page_convention: One selected WL and SSL, all 13824 BL; do not replace with Micron 16-KiB product page

read.reported_range_applicability: Conditional budget: same native dimensions and ~16 pF SL; input duplication brings current toward source regime; retained 12 ns BL budget under stated load. Reset/transimpedance settling must fit listed stages, else add nonnegative extra time.
read.wl_schedule: For each of eight WL/output groups: one WL setup, then eight input-bit evaluations; all eight weight planes parallel.

unknowns: P: full single SLC-CIM page program including target-current write-verify and recovery
E: full block erase including erase verify and recovery
C_app/C_rw: total additional calibration time per full-matrix transaction; initial state and new back patterns determine need
resident.append_initial_state: All eight data WLs erased; calibration WL(s) already programmed. C_app may be zero only if new layout/back pattern preserves valid calibration.
resident.rewrite: Whole matrix replaced at same eight data WL addresses; 128 blocks erased in one serial update domain; calibration pages rebuilt; no copy-forward of unrelated state.

shared_exceptions.change: Two native 64-block subarrays implement 128 simultaneous scalar partial sums; eight binary bit planes ×16 output lanes; eight WL groups provide128 outputs
shared_exceptions.effect: Counts remain64 evaluations/64 ADC batches/128 reconstruction ticks; added8 WL setups; no independent input replication

shared_exceptions.change: 108 copies of each logical input/weight bit across full physical page; only one SSL active
shared_exceptions.effect: Same input-bit/evaluation count and logical payload; scalar current normalized by108 before/throughADC calibration; encoded data per logical128-bit plane-page is13824 bits; analog applicability conditional

shared_exceptions.change: Use NAND-04 WL/BL/SL component estimates; 32 nm low-voltage peripheral replaced by shared28 nm slots, HV geometry kept
shared_exceptions.effect: acim_service uses BL+SL; eight separate WL-setup blocks added; no ordinary tR or1us double-count

shared_exceptions.change: Native page1728 Byte but16 Byte logical bit payload; full matrix1024 data pages; one or two additional calibration pages per block
shared_exceptions.effect: Full transaction BR16384 Byte; 128serialblockerase; Np/e=8 useful pages, not32or96; calibrationprogram consumes time only
tau/ridge remain explicit functions; no MLC/TLC/QLC substitution or invented typical times

method_issues: Media-dependent stages with different invocation counts (WL per output group, BL/SL per input bit) are handled by existing explicit sequential composition and exception rules; scalar t_m must not silently charge WL64 times or amortize over unlimited vectors.
Native physical page payload can be only a weight-bit slice; aggregate all8 planes/allstate before crediting complete INT8 payload.
Erase also destroys calibration state; useful pages per erase excludes calibration and unusedWL/SSL.
ADC sharing and array output selection differ: NAND block has one SL scalar, multiple outputs reside on different WLs.
No SLC-CIM program/erase absolute timing exists in supplied corpus; ratio-onlySLC burst and dense product throughput cannot bound it.
